title: Altar of Zul
wikitext:
[[Image:Altar of Zul.jpg|thumb|The Altar of Zul]]
A [[forest troll]] altar.  It contains the mysterious Sacred Mallet (dropped from Qiaga the Keeper) that can be charged to create the [[Mallet of Zul'Farrak]].
